reasoning: On the season so far the Grizzlies are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 9 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Nets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 66 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 203 and 251 total points.

analyst.text: Brooklyn come in with a lift after routing New Orleans 145-111. Noah Clowney, frustrated after losing his starting role, responded with 16 points, and Jordi Fernandez wants him to stay out of foul trouble. Memphis are on a back-to-back and only 2-4 at home. Tuomas Iisalo is under scrutiny for late-game decisions, though Ty Jerome is on a run of 20-point games heading into free agency. The lean is mild toward Memphis, with the fatigue and home struggles keeping it close.
